title.zh: Active campaign 原样延续（认捐）

inputs.label: campaign
inputs.body: Cell{ capacity: C, lock: { codeHash: CAMPAIGN_LOCK, args: {{deadline_block 8B}} } }

body.zh: Cell{ lock: {{同一 lock}}, data(≥65B)[56] = {{0 Active}}, {{capacity ≥ C}} }
body.en: Cell{ lock: {{same lock}}, data(≥65B)[56] = {{0 Active}}, {{capacity ≥ C}} }

cons.zh: 非延续路径要求 since ≥ 它

cond.zh: 找到的第一个同 lock、data ≥ 65B 且 status = 0 的输出 capacity ≥ 输入
cond.en: first output with same lock, data ≥ 65B and status 0 has capacity ≥ input

title.zh: 截止后任意花费（结算 / 销毁）
title.en: Any spend after the deadline (finalize / destroy)

label.zh: outputs：任意（规则由 campaign 类型脚本约束）
label.en: outputs: any (rules from the campaign type script)

cond.zh: 第一个 group 输入的 since 必须绝对、标志合法、按区块号
cond.en: first group input since must be absolute, valid flags, block number

cond.zh: 区块号 ≥ deadline_block（since = 0 视为区块 0）
cond.en: block number ≥ deadline_block (since = 0 counts as block 0)

notes.zh: 错误码（main.rs）：10 INVALID_ARGS · 11 LOAD_SINCE · 12 INVALID_SINCE · 13 SINCE_BELOW_DEADLINE · 14 LOAD_CELL · 15 CAPACITY_DECREASED
notes.en: Error codes (main.rs): 10 INVALID_ARGS · 11 LOAD_SINCE · 12 INVALID_SINCE · 13 SINCE_BELOW_DEADLINE · 14 LOAD_CELL · 15 CAPACITY_DECREASED

notes.zh: 不检查任何签名：谁都可以推进 campaign；内容合法性由 campaign 类型脚本保证
notes.en: No signature is checked: anyone can move the campaign; validity comes from the campaign type script

notes.zh: 部署清单 deployed-contracts-testnet.json 把 campaignLock 写成 hashType data，但链上实际交易与前端 constants.ts 都使用 data2
notes.en: deployment/deployed-contracts-testnet.json lists campaignLock as hashType data, but on-chain txs and frontend constants.ts use data2
